name: Morningdew the Elder
summary: In Thousand Needles, pilgrims seek Morningdew the Elder beneath a beam of starlight during the Lunar Festival. She offers wisdom and directions to elders across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Celestial Presence in the Canyons
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, ancient ancestor spirits appear across Azeroth to bless travelers. In Thousand Needles, Morningdew the Elder stands beneath a shaft of lunar light, amid red stone and industrial noise. She urges mortal travelers to turn from earthly concerns and look to the stars.

sections.title: Wisdom of the Heavens
sections.body: Morningdew points seekers toward the countless stars for answers to earthly mysteries. She also guides festival pilgrims to other honored spirits across the lands: Elder High Mountain, Elder Grimtotem, Elder Mistwalker, Elder Moonwarden, and Elder Windtotem.

faq.answer: Morningdew the Elder is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival. Beneath starlight, she offers wisdom and guides travelers who come to honor the elders.

faq.q: Where can Elder Morningdew be found?
faq.answer: You can find Morningdew the Elder in Thousand Needles, beneath a bright pillar of light from the sky.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting Elder Morningdew?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, travelers visit Morningdew to honor the ancestors, receive their blessings, and learn where other elders can be found.

faq.q: Which other elders does Morningdew know about?
faq.answer: Morningdew gives directions to Elder High Mountain, Elder Grimtotem, Elder Mistwalker, Elder Moonwarden, and Elder Windtotem.

faq.q: Why is there a pillar of light shining down on her?
faq.answer: A beam of celestial starlight shines on each ancestral spirit during the Lunar Festival, marking their presence and bond with the heavens.
Morningdew teaches pilgrims to seek answers to earthly mysteries among the countless stars. She urges the wise and fortunate to look upward for truth.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see the Lunar Festival's celestial elders as a link to Elune, nature, and the ancestral communion honored by Cenarion circles.
As a shaman, you know that communion with honored spirits like Morningdew helps you understand the balance between ancestors and elements throughout the world.
As a night elf, you recognize in the elders beneath starlight an ancient tradition of honoring the heavens and Kalimdor's old wisdom.
As a tauren, you know that reverence for ancestral elders is central to your culture. A pilgrimage to spirits like Morningdew holds deep meaning.
